p14_replay_start.authority: Coordinator authorised repair of the concrete served emergency declaration replay defect, including its current UI and focused tests; no test execution by this worker.
p14_replay_start.witness: Reposting a declaration currently recomputes utcnow and appends another expiry. A lost response can therefore renew an exception without a new deliberate declaration.
p14_replay_start.invariant: A stable explicit request key owns one immutable normalised request and one original declaration/expiry. Exact retries only read that receipt, changed requests conflict, and expiry/revocation remain effective on replay.
scope: tests/js/matter_workspace.mjs and its existing pytest dispatcher

Require a request_key before declaration. UI keeps unresolved keys in current-session memory and clears them on confirmed acceptance or session end.
p14_replay_start.proof_intent: Real served response/retry, expiry, revocation, conflict, missing/damaged identity, save failure and CAS conflict. Existing Node controller witness checks key reuse after a lost response and fresh key after deliberate accepted redeclaration. All earlier assertions retained.
p14_replay_start.implementation_detail: No new domain type was needed. Matter.emergencies retains request_key and request_offer beside the existing declaration. Revocation updates only the governing equal-timestamp append and preserves its original request metadata, preventing revival or erasure of a separate accepted key. A CAS loser receives explicit409 and can reread/retry the same key; no automatic new command is minted.
